f3_program: consume("bugs_eat_today", "bugs", at("garden.plants.count", "current"), 20, source("The bugs are very hungry today and completely ate 20 plants"))

consume("bugs_eat_next_day", "bugs", at("garden.plants.count", "current"), fraction(at("garden.plants.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("The next day, they were still full and only ate half of the remaining plants"))
consume("bugs_eat_after_that", "bugs", at("garden.plants.count", "current"), 1, source("After that, they ate only 1 of the plants that were left"))

offset(at("certain_house.construction_cost", "current"), at("other_house.construction_cost", "current"), 100000, "currency", source("The cost of building a certain house in an area is 100,000 more than the construction cost of each of the houses in the area"))
multiple(at("certain_house.sale_price", "current"), at("other_house.sale_price", "current"), 1.5, source("it sells for 1.5 times as much as the other houses"))
assumptions: The certain house is contrasted with a representative one of the other houses, and the requested difference runs from the other house's profit to the certain house's profit.
Computing the initial balance requires converting one year into months, a time-unit conversion not stated in the source or supplied by the F3-v1 allowlist.
Change is interpreted as the signed difference from 2018 to 2019, rather than as a percentage change.
